instruction: Query the OQMD database twice for Li ternary compounds (element_set=Li AND ntypes=3, limit=1 each time). Read the total count (data_available from API metadata) from each query and save as 'Total Li ternary compounds' and 'Stable Li ternary compounds' to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_9.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
